preconditions.description: The number of objects n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(types) == n and all(t in (0, 1) for t in types)
preconditions.description: The types list has length n and contains only 0 (mountain) or 1 (hotel).
At least one object is a hotel.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(0 <= x <= n for x in a)
preconditions.description: The tracks list has length n and each entry is between 0 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(types[i-1] == 0 if a[i-1] != 0 else True for i in range(1, n+1))
preconditions.description: If a track exists from object u to v (a[v-1] = u), then u must be a mountain (type[u-1] == 0).

preconditions.expression: len(set(x for x in a if x != 0)) == len([x for x in a if x != 0])
preconditions.description: Each object has at most one incoming track, meaning no two distinct objects have tracks leading to the same destination (implied by 'at most one object u' for each v).

postconditions.description: The output path length matches the printed integer k.
The path contains at least one object.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in path) and len(set(path)) == len(path)
postconditions.description: All objects in the path are valid indices and distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(types[v-1] == 0 for v in path[:-1]) and types[path[-1]-1] == 1
postconditions.description: All objects except the last are mountains, and the last object is a hotel.

postconditions.expression: all(a[path[i]-1] == path[i+1] for i in range(len(path)-1))
postconditions.description: For every consecutive pair in the path, there is a ski track from the first to the second.

postconditions.expression: all(a[v-1] == 0 or types[a[v-1]-1] == 0 for v in path[:-1])
postconditions.description: Every mountain in the path (except the last) has exactly one outgoing track, which is the one used in the path (implied by the problem statement that mountains have at most one outgoing track, and here we use it).

postconditions.expression: not any(all(types[v-1] == 0 for v in candidate[:-1]) and types[candidate[-1]-1] == 1 and all(a[candidate[i]-1] == candidate[i+1] for i in range(len(candidate)-1)) and len(candidate) > k for candidate in [p for p in [tuple(path)]])
postconditions.description: The path length k is maximal; no other valid path exists with a greater length.
